name: Sudan
summary: UN rights office says drone strikes killed over 1,630 civilians in Sudan from January to October; no ceasefire
state: The UN Human Rights Office reported on 19 Nov that drone strikes killed more than 1,630 civilians in Sudan between January and October 2026, about 73% of confirmed civilian deaths, and attributed 29 strikes on power and fuel sites to the RSF (Defense Post). Amnesty International said on 18 Nov that RSF drone strikes on El Obeid should be investigated as war crimes (Sudan Tribune). The UN warned on 18 Nov of a rising toll as the army pushed towards RSF strongholds in Kordofan. Repeated mass-casualty attacks keep the Alert; searches on 28 Nov found no ceasefire.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan. Civilians in Kordofan, Darfur and Blue Nile are most exposed; strikes on power and fuel sites tend to cut water, health care and food supplies far from the front lines.
rubric_hit: Alert: repeated mass-casualty attacks on civilians reported (UN: 1,630+ civilians killed by drones Jan–Oct 2026)
